Container.Name: ReqogniLoom
Container.Overview:
ReqogniLoom is an AI-native Requirements and Test Management tool with MBSE support. This template installs the frontend UI and triggers the full 8-container stack deployment via Compose Manager Plus.
IMPORTANT: This template does NOT manage all 8 containers directly (postgres, postgres-backup, redis, backend, migrate, celery, celery-beat, frontend). Instead, it serves as the entry point: Compose Manager Plus handles the full stack using deployment/unraid/docker-compose.yaml.
Before first use: 1. Install Unraid Compose Manager Plus plugin (or equivalent Docker Compose orchestrator) 2. Import the stack from the git repo: https://github.com/Popoboxxo/ReqogniLoom/tree/main/deployment/unraid/ 3. Configure environment variables (.env) with your secrets (DB_PASSWORD, REDIS_PASSWORD, SYSTEM_ADMIN_PASSWORD, etc.) 4. Start the stack via Compose Manager Plus — all 8 services will launch in proper dependency order (migrate runs the REQ-188 self-init before backend/celery start)
This template configures the frontend container specifically (port 5554, Vite build-time variables). Refer to README.md in deployment/unraid/ for full setup instructions.

Config.Name: VITE_API_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Frontend API endpoint (must be reachable from browser). Examples: http://localhost:8000, https://crm.example.com:8443, https://api.example.com

Config.Name: VITE_ALLOWED_HOSTS
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of allowed frontend hosts (used for API CORS checks)

Config.Name: Frontend Port
Config.Description: Port where frontend is accessible (mapped to internal port 80)

Config.Name: ReqogniLoom Data Path
Config.Description: Unraid host path for ReqogniLoom data (databases, backups, logs). Subdirectories: /db (postgres), /backup, /scripts

Config.Name: DB_PASSWORD
Config.Description: PostgreSQL database password (generate with: python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))')

Config.Name: REDIS_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Redis broker password (generate with: python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(24))')

Config.Name: SYSTEM_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Initial admin password (required on first start, never reset if admin changes it via UI). Minimum 12 characters recommended.

Config.Name: SYSTEM_ADMIN_USERNAME
Config.Description: Initial admin username (create-only, used on first bootstrap only)

Config.Name: SYSTEM_ADMIN_EMAIL
Config.Description: Initial admin email (create-only, used on first bootstrap only)

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Django secret key (generate with: python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(50))'). NEVER reuse across deployments.

Config.Name: DEBUG
Config.Description: Django debug mode (True=development, False=production). Keep False for production deployments.

Config.Name: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed for cross-origin requests (e.g., frontend domain)

Config.Name: CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed to POST/PATCH/DELETE (should match CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS)

Config.Name: ALLOWED_HOSTS
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of hostnames/IPs where Django serves requests (must include your domain)

Config.Name: LLM_PROVIDER
Config.Description: LLM provider: anthropic, openai, ollama, or mock (default, no AI features). Gracefully degrades if provider unavailable.

Config.Name: LLM_API_KEY
Config.Description: API key for cloud LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI). Not used for ollama or mock.

Config.Name: LLM_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Base URL for Ollama or self-hosted LLM (e.g., http://172.10.1.111:11434). Not used for cloud providers.

Config.Name: LLM_MODEL
Config.Description: Model name/tag for LLM provider (e.g., for Ollama: qwen2.5:14b, for OpenAI: gpt-4)

Config.Name: BACKUP_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Seconds between postgres backups (default: 86400 = 24 hours)

Config.Name: BACKUP_RETENTION
Config.Description: Number of postgres backups to retain (default: 7)

Config.Name: DEFAULT_TENANT_ID
Config.Description: Default tenant ID for single-tenant deployments (keep as 1 unless multi-tenant setup)

Config.Name: REPO_ROOT
Config.Description: Absolute path to ReqogniLoom repo checkout on this Unraid host (needed if building images locally). Example: /mnt/user/appdata/ReqogniLoom
